example.title: Check a training group's trigger-zone status from the F10 menu
example.keywords: f10 trigger zone menu mission group status circle training check radio gruppenstatus gruppe triggerzone kreiszone zone prüfen menü menüpunkt befehl beispiel trainingsgruppe
setup: Create a circular trigger zone named LZ Alpha in the DCS Mission Editor.
Create a group named Training Flight. Place it or route it so that a unit can cross the zone boundary while the mission is running.
Load the MOOSE 2.9.19 Moose.lua first and f10-trigger-zone.lua second, using Do Script File actions at mission start.
Enter a player slot and select F10 Other > Training > Check LZ Alpha.
expected: All players see whether at least one unit in Training Flight is inside LZ Alpha at the time the command is selected.
Repeat the command with the group completely outside the zone to see the outside message.
With a missing or inactive group, the command reports that the group is unavailable. With a missing zone, the script leaves the menu unregistered and MOOSE logs the lookup error.
